```{r}
set.seed(42)

# ============================================================
# pILC RNA-seq: hypothesis-driven chromatin pathway analysis
# Date: 2026-09-24
#
# Analyses
#   1. DESeq2 VST from raw HTSeq counts
#   2. ENSG-to-HGNC mapping audit (unresolved ENSG IDs are retained)
#   3. Focused pathway extraction from MSigDB C5
#   4. Curated chromatin-remodeling and chromatin-protein-modification sets
#   5. Sample-level ssGSEA pathway scores and cluster comparisons
#   6. Cluster-versus-rest and pairwise DESeq2 ranking with fgseaMultilevel
#   7. Pathway, GSEA and leading-edge visualizations
#
# Display labels  # [LABELS]
#   Original pathway IDs (e.g. C5__GOCC_GBAF_COMPLEX) are kept unchanged in
#   all data objects. Figures show cleaned labels (e.g. "GBAF complex [GO-CC]"),
#   and result tables carry both the ID and a Pathway_label column.
#
# Clinical annotation  # [CLINICAL]
#   Sample-level heatmaps hide sample names and show clinical tracks
#   (tumor cellularity, pleomorphic cellularity, TILs, grade, HER2, ER, PR)
#   below the matrix, using the same parsing rules and colors as the
#   functional-category oncoplot script.
#
# Important interpretation
#   The three clusters were derived from these expression data. Results
#   characterize the clusters and do not constitute independent validation.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  required_packages <- c(
    "DESeq2", "data.table", "fgsea", "GSVA", "ggplot2",
    "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "grid", "AnnotationDbi", "org.Hs.eg.db"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
      "\nInstall Bioconductor packages with:\n",
      "if (!requireNamespace('BiocManager', quietly=TRUE)) install.packages('BiocManager')\n",
      "BiocManager::install(c(",
      paste(sprintf("'%s'", missing_packages), collapse = ", "),
      "))"
    )
  }

  library(DESeq2)
  library(data.table)
  library(fgsea)
  library(GSVA)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
})

graphics.off()

# ============================================================
# Input and output paths
# ============================================================

count_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/VST_data/htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv"

cluster_gct_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/GenePattern_NMFConsensus/vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct"

c5_gmt_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"

# [CLINICAL] Same clinical file used by the functional-category oncoplot script
clinical_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation/pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"

out_root <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Focused_Chromatin_Pathway_Analysis"

run_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
out_dir <- file.path(
  out_root,
  paste0("pILC_Focused_Chromatin_Pathway_Analysis_", run_date)
)
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")

dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_files <- c(
  count_file = count_file,
  cluster_gct_file = cluster_gct_file,
  c5_gmt_file = c5_gmt_file,
  clinical_file = clinical_file          # [CLINICAL]
)

missing_inputs <- names(input_files)[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required input file(s) not found:\n",
    paste0(missing_inputs, ": ", input_files[missing_inputs], collapse = "\n")
  )
}

fwrite(
  data.table(Input = names(input_files), Path = unname(input_files)),
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("input_file_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

clean_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x
}

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
}

zscore_rows <- function(mat, cap = 2.5) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z[z > cap] <- cap
  z[z < -cap] <- -cap
  z
}

prefix_pathways <- function(pathways, prefix) {
  if (!length(pathways)) return(list())
  pathways <- lapply(pathways, function(g) unique(clean_gene(g)))
  pathways <- lapply(pathways, function(g) g[g != ""])
  names(pathways) <- paste0(prefix, "__", make.unique(names(pathways)))
  pathways
}

write_matrix_tsv <- function(mat, row_name, file) {
  dt <- as.data.table(mat, keep.rownames = row_name)
  fwrite(dt, file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# [LABELS] Pathway display-label helpers
#
# These functions convert a pathway ID such as
#   C5__GOMF_HISTONE_H3K27_METHYLTRANSFERASE_ACTIVITY
# into a readable figure label such as
#   Histone H3K27 methyltransferase activity [GO-MF]
# The IDs themselves are never modified.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Words that must stay fully upper case after sentence-casing.
label_acronyms <- c(
  "DNA", "RNA", "ATP", "SWI/SNF", "BAF", "GBAF", "BBAF", "NBAF", "NPBAF",
  "PBAF", "NURF", "INO80", "SWR1", "PRC1", "PRC2", "HAT", "HDAC", "SUMO",
  "TET", "DNMT", "SAGA", "ATAC", "NUA4", "ISWI", "CENP", "MLL", "COMPASS",
  "SIN3"
)

# Words with a fixed mixed-case spelling.
label_special_case <- c(
  RDNA = "rDNA", NURD = "NuRD", MRNA = "mRNA", TRNA = "tRNA", RRNA = "rRNA"
)

# Phrase-level fixes applied after the label is assembled
# (hyphens, parentheses and small wording improvements).
label_phrase_fixes <- c(
  "ATP dependent" = "ATP-dependent",
  "elongation coupled" = "elongation-coupled",
  "superfamily type" = "superfamily-type",
  "activity hydrolytic mechanism" = "activity (hydrolytic mechanism)",
  "SWI/SNF BAF" = "SWI/SNF-BAF",
  "acetyltransferase HAT" = "acetyltransferase (HAT)",
  "writers readers" = "writers and readers",
  "phosphorylation DNA damage" = "phosphorylation (DNA damage)",
  "remodeling expanded" = "remodeling (expanded)"
)

# Format a single word: keep acronyms and histone marks, lower-case the rest.
format_label_word <- function(word) {
  if (word %in% names(label_special_case)) return(label_special_case[[word]])
  if (word %in% label_acronyms) return(word)
  # Histone names and marks: H3, H4, H2A, H2AX, H2AZ, H3K27, H4K16, ...
  if (grepl("^H[1-4](A|B)?(X|Z)?[0-9]*(K[0-9]+)?$", word)) return(word)
  tolower(word)
}

# Convert one pathway ID into a display label.
clean_one_label <- function(pathway_id) {
  # Step 1: source prefix (C5, CURATED) and the term without it.
  source_code <- sub("__.*$", "", pathway_id)
  term <- sub("^[A-Za-z0-9]+__", "", pathway_id)

  # Step 2: remove the ".1", ".2" suffix added by make.unique().
  term <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", term)

  # Step 3: build the short source tag; for C5, use the GO sub-ontology.
  source_tag <- switch(
    source_code,
    CURATED = "Curated",
    source_code
  )
  if (source_code == "C5") {
    ontology <- sub("_.*$", "", term)
    ontology_tags <- c(GOBP = "GO-BP", GOCC = "GO-CC", GOMF = "GO-MF", HP = "HPO")
    if (ontology %in% names(ontology_tags)) {
      source_tag <- ontology_tags[[ontology]]
      term <- sub("^[A-Z]+_", "", term)
    }
  }

  # Step 4: split into words; keep SWI/SNF together as one word.
  term <- toupper(term)
  term <- gsub("SWI_SNF", "SWI/SNF", term, fixed = TRUE)
  words <- strsplit(term, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  words <- words[words != ""]
  if (!length(words)) return(pathway_id)

  # Step 5: sentence case with protected acronyms and histone marks.
  words <- vapply(words, format_label_word, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  if (words[1] == tolower(words[1])) {
    substr(words[1], 1, 1) <- toupper(substr(words[1], 1, 1))
  }
  label <- paste(words, collapse = " ")

  # Step 6: phrase-level wording fixes.
  for (phrase in names(label_phrase_fixes)) {
    label <- gsub(phrase, label_phrase_fixes[[phrase]], label, fixed = TRUE)
  }

  paste0(label, " [", source_tag, "]")
}

# Look up display labels for a vector of pathway IDs.
# pathway_label_map is created after the final pathway list is defined.
# IDs missing from the map fall back to the original ID.
pathway_label <- function(ids) {
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  labels <- unname(pathway_label_map[ids])
  ifelse(is.na(labels), ids, labels)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# [CLINICAL] Helpers for the clinical annotation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Join key used ONLY to match RNA samples to the clinical table.
# (clean_sample() above is unchanged and still used for count matching.)
#   1. upper-case and trim
#   2. remove the GenePattern "_S#" suffix
#   3. remove a tumor suffix: "_T", "-T" or ".T"
#   4. remove all separators so "TP03-117", "TP03.117" and "TP03_117" match
clinical_key <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- sub("[-_.]T$", "", x)
  gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", x)
}

# Percent text -> numeric; "<5" is coded as half the bound (2.5),
# the same rule as in the oncoplot script.
parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_
  is_less_than <- grepl("^<", x)
  val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x)))
  val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] <- val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] / 2
  val
}

# Receptor text -> Positive / Negative / Unknown
clean_receptor_status <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[grepl("^Positive", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^Negative", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Negative"
  out[is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- "Unknown"
  out
}

# Grade text -> cleaned text; missing values become "Unknown"
clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- "Unknown"
  x
}

# ============================================================
# Read NMF cluster membership
# ============================================================

cluster_dt <- fread(cluster_gct_file, skip = 2, data.table = TRUE)

required_cluster_cols <- c("Name", "Description")
if (!all(required_cluster_cols %in% names(cluster_dt))) {
  stop("Cluster GCT must contain Name and Description columns.")
}

membership_cols <- grep("^membership", names(cluster_dt), value = TRUE)
if (length(membership_cols) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one membership column in cluster GCT; found: ",
    paste(membership_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cluster_dt <- cluster_dt[
  ,
  .(
    Sample_original = Name,
    Sample = clean_sample(Name),
    Cluster_number = as.integer(get(membership_cols[1]))
  )
]

if (anyNA(cluster_dt$Cluster_number)) {
  stop("Non-numeric or missing cluster memberships detected.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(cluster_dt$Sample)) {
  stop("Duplicate samples after removing GenePattern _S suffixes.")
}

cluster_dt[, Cluster := factor(
  paste0("Cluster ", Cluster_number),
  levels = c("Cluster 1", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3")
)]

if (anyNA(cluster_dt$Cluster)) {
  stop("Cluster membership must be 1, 2 or 3.")
}

cluster_colors <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77",
  "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02",
  "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3"
)

# ============================================================
# Centralized figure styling
# ============================================================

figure_text_color <- "#000000"

# ggplot font sizes
figure_base_size <- 14
figure_title_size <- 18
figure_subtitle_size <- 13
figure_axis_size <- 12
figure_small_text_size <- 10

# ComplexHeatmap font sizes
heatmap_row_fontsize <- 9      # [LABELS] used for pathway row labels
heatmap_column_fontsize <- 10

# [LABELS] Font size for pathway labels on ggplot y-axes
pathway_label_text_size <- 9

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# [CLINICAL] Colors (identical to the oncoplot script)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I"   = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II"  = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown"   = "#BDBDBD"
)

binary_receptor_cols <- c(
  "Negative" = "#1F78B4",
  "Positive" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown"  = "#BDBDBD"
)

setorder(cluster_dt, Cluster_number)

fwrite(
  cluster_dt,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    paste0("pILC_cluster_metadata_", run_date, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

message("Cluster sizes:")
print(cluster_dt[, .N, by = Cluster])

# ============================================================
# [CLINICAL] Read clinical annotations and match to RNA samples
# ============================================================

clinical_raw <- fread(
  clinical_file,
  sep = ",", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A")
)

# Exact column names from the clinical CSV (same as the oncoplot script).
required_clinical_cols <- c(
  "Sample",
  "tumor_cellularity (%)",
  "pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)",
  "TILs (%)",
  "Grade/Differentiation-Desc",
  "BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc",
  "Tumor Marker #1 (ER)",
  "Tumor Marker #2 (PR)"
)
missing_clinical_cols <- setdiff(required_clinical_cols, names(clinical_raw))
if (length(missing_clinical_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Clinical file is missing column(s): ",
    paste(missing_clinical_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Parse each clinical feature with the same rules as the oncoplot script.
clinical_dt <- clinical_raw[, .(
  Clinical_sample       = as.character(Sample),
  Sample_key            = clinical_key(Sample),
  Tumor_cellularity_pct = parse_percent_value(`tumor_cellularity (%)`),
  Pleomorphic_pct       = parse_percent_value(`pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`),
  TILs_pct              = parse_percent_value(`TILs (%)`),
  Grade                 = clean_grade_status(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`),
  HER2                  = clean_receptor_status(`BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc`),
  ER                    = clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #1 (ER)`),
  PR                    = clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #2 (PR)`)
)]
clinical_dt <- clinical_dt[!is.na(Sample_key) & Sample_key != ""]

if (anyDuplicated(clinical_dt$Sample_key)) {
  warning("Duplicate clinical sample keys found; keeping the first row for each.")
  clinical_dt <- unique(clinical_dt, by = "Sample_key")
}

# RNA samples in plotting order (cluster_dt is already sorted by cluster).
rna_key_dt <- data.table(
  Column_index = seq_len(nrow(cluster_dt)),
  Sample       = cluster_dt$Sample,
  Sample_key   = clinical_key(cluster_dt$Sample),
  Cluster      = cluster_dt$Cluster
)
if (anyDuplicated(rna_key_dt$Sample_key)) {
  stop("Two RNA samples collapse to the same clinical key; check sample IDs.")
}

# Left join: every RNA sample is kept; unmatched samples get NA clinical values.
sample_clinical_dt <- merge(
  rna_key_dt, clinical_dt,
  by = "Sample_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)
setorder(sample_clinical_dt, Column_index)
sample_clinical_dt[, Clinical_matched := !is.na(Clinical_sample)]

# Unmatched samples: categorical tracks show "Unknown";
# numeric tracks stay NA and are drawn grey.
for (cc in c("Grade", "HER2", "ER", "PR")) {
  sample_clinical_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := "Unknown"]
}

message(
  "RNA samples matched to clinical data: ",
  sum(sample_clinical_dt$Clinical_matched), " / ", nrow(sample_clinical_dt)
)
if (any(!sample_clinical_dt$Clinical_matched)) {
  warning(
    "RNA samples without clinical match: ",
    paste(sample_clinical_dt[Clinical_matched == FALSE, Sample], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Saved in the same column order as the heatmaps (paired table for the figures).
setcolorder(sample_clinical_dt, c("Column_index", "Sample", "Sample_key", "Cluster"))
fwrite(
  sample_clinical_dt,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("pILC_RNA_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# [CLINICAL] Bottom clinical annotation builder
# sample_order must be identical to the heatmap matrix column order.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_clinical_annotation <- function(sample_order) {

  clin <- sample_clinical_dt[match(sample_order, Sample)]

  anno_df <- data.frame(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = clin$Tumor_cellularity_pct,
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = clin$Pleomorphic_pct,
    `TILs (%)`        = clin$TILs_pct,
    Grade             = clin$Grade,
    HER2              = clin$HER2,
    ER                = clin$ER,
    PR                = clin$PR,
    check.names = FALSE,
    row.names = sample_order
  )

  # Any grade label not in the palette gets an automatic color.
  grade_cols_local <- grade_cols
  extra_grades <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(anno_df$Grade)), names(grade_cols))
  if (length(extra_grades) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- hcl.colors(length(extra_grades), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_cols) <- extra_grades
    grade_cols_local <- c(grade_cols_local, extra_cols)
  }

  anno_cols <- list(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")),
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")),
    `TILs (%)`        = colorRamp2(c(0, 30, 100), c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")),
    Grade = grade_cols_local,
    HER2  = binary_receptor_cols,
    ER    = binary_receptor_cols,
    PR    = binary_receptor_cols
  )

  HeatmapAnnotation(
    # Small empty spacer separates the heatmap body from the clinical tracks.
    ` ` = anno_empty(height = unit(1, "mm"), border = FALSE),
    df = anno_df,
    col = anno_cols,
    na_col = "grey90",
    which = "column",
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_rot = 0,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.30, "cm"),
    gap = unit(c(3.5, rep(1.1, ncol(anno_df) - 1)), "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, ncol(anno_df))),
    # HER2, ER and PR share colors, so one legend is shown for all three.
    show_legend = c(
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = TRUE, `Pleomorphic (%)` = TRUE, `TILs (%)` = TRUE,
      Grade = TRUE, HER2 = TRUE, ER = FALSE, PR = FALSE
    ),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = list(title = "Tumor cell. (%)"),
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = list(title = "Pleomorphic (%)"),
      `TILs (%)`        = list(title = "TILs (%)"),
      Grade = list(title = "Grade"),
      # Fixed levels so "Positive" stays in the legend even if no tumor is HER2+.
      HER2  = list(
        title = "HER2 / ER / PR",
        at = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown")
      )
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# [CLINICAL] Draw one heatmap to PDF and PNG with identical size (inches)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
save_heatmap_pdf_png <- function(ht, file_stem, width_in, height_in) {
  draw_ht <- function() {
    draw(
      ht,
      heatmap_legend_side = "right",
      annotation_legend_side = "right",
      merge_legends = TRUE,                 # one stacked legend column
      padding = unit(c(4, 4, 6, 4), "mm")
    )
  }

  pdf(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_stem, "_", run_date, ".pdf")),
    width = width_in, height = height_in
  )
  draw_ht()
  dev.off()

  png(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_stem, "_", run_date, ".png")),
    width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in", res = 300
  )
  draw_ht()
  dev.off()
}

# ============================================================
# Read and validate raw HTSeq counts
# ============================================================

count_dt <- fread(count_file, data.table = TRUE)
if (!("Gene" %in% names(count_dt))) {
  stop("Count file must contain a column named Gene.")
}

count_dt[, Gene_input := trimws(as.character(Gene))]
count_dt[, Gene_clean := clean_gene(Gene_input)]
count_dt <- count_dt[Gene_clean != "" & !grepl("^__", Gene_clean)]

# DESeq2 does not convert Ensembl IDs to symbols. Map only ENSG identifiers,
# strip optional version suffixes, and retain unresolved IDs explicitly.
count_dt[, Is_ENSG := grepl(
  "^ENSG[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?$",
  Gene_clean,
  perl = TRUE
)]
count_dt[, Ensembl_base := fifelse(
  Is_ENSG,
  sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", Gene_clean),
  NA_character_
)]

ensembl_ids <- unique(na.omit(count_dt$Ensembl_base))
ensembl_to_symbol <- if (length(ensembl_ids)) {
  AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = ensembl_ids,
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
} else {
  setNames(character(), character())
}

count_dt[, Mapped_symbol := NA_character_]
if (length(ensembl_to_symbol)) {
  count_dt[
    Is_ENSG == TRUE,
    Mapped_symbol := unname(ensembl_to_symbol[Ensembl_base])
  ]
}
count_dt[, Gene := fifelse(
  Is_ENSG & !is.na(Mapped_symbol) & Mapped_symbol != "",
  toupper(Mapped_symbol),
  fifelse(Is_ENSG, Ensembl_base, Gene_clean)
)]

gene_id_audit <- unique(count_dt[, .(
  Gene_input,
  Gene_clean,
  Is_ENSG,
  Ensembl_base,
  Mapped_symbol,
  Analysis_gene = Gene,
  Mapping_status = fifelse(
    !Is_ENSG,
    "Input_not_ENSG",
    fifelse(!is.na(Mapped_symbol) & Mapped_symbol != "", "ENSG_mapped", "ENSG_unresolved")
  )
)])

fwrite(
  gene_id_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("gene_identifier_mapping_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

fwrite(
  gene_id_audit[, .N, by = Mapping_status][order(Mapping_status)],
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("gene_identifier_mapping_summary_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

sample_cols <- setdiff(
  names(count_dt),
  c(
    "Gene", "Gene_input", "Gene_clean", "Is_ENSG", "Ensembl_base",
    "Mapped_symbol"
  )
)

missing_samples <- setdiff(cluster_dt$Sample, sample_cols)
extra_samples <- setdiff(sample_cols, cluster_dt$Sample)

if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Cluster samples missing from the count matrix: ",
    paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (length(extra_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Count-matrix samples without cluster assignments: ",
    paste(extra_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Aggregate duplicate symbols if upper-casing or annotation produced duplicates.
count_dt <- count_dt[
  ,
  lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = Gene,
  .SDcols = sample_cols
]

count_dt <- count_dt[, c("Gene", cluster_dt$Sample), with = FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_dt[, -"Gene"])
rownames(count_matrix) <- count_dt$Gene
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"

if (anyNA(count_matrix)) stop("Missing count values detected.")
if (any(count_matrix < 0)) stop("Negative count values detected.")
if (any(count_matrix != round(count_matrix))) {
  stop("The HTSeq input contains non-integer values; raw counts are required.")
}
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"

metadata <- data.frame(
  Sample = cluster_dt$Sample,
  Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster,
  row.names = cluster_dt$Sample,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# DESeq2 normalization and VST
# ============================================================

dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ Cluster
)

# Retain genes with at least 10 reads in at least 3 tumors.
keep_gene <- rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 10) >= 3

filter_audit <- data.table(
  Gene = rownames(dds0),
  Total_count = rowSums(counts(dds0)),
  Samples_with_count_ge_10 = rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 10),
  Retained = keep_gene
)

fwrite(
  filter_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("gene_filter_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

dds <- dds0[keep_gene, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", parallel = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)

vst_object <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vst_matrix <- assay(vst_object)

normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

write_matrix_tsv(
  normalized_counts,
  "Gene",
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("DESeq2_normalized_counts_", run_date, ".tsv"))
)

write_matrix_tsv(
  vst_matrix,
  "Gene",
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("DESeq2_VST_expression_", run_date, ".tsv"))
)

# ============================================================
# Read pathway collections
# ============================================================

c5_all <- prefix_pathways(fgsea::gmtPathways(c5_gmt_file), "C5")

# Strict, hypothesis-driven pathway selection.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# The earlier broad search included any term containing words such as
# "METHYLTRANSFERASE" or "DEUBIQUITINATION". That unintentionally admitted
# RNA methylation, histone-mRNA metabolism, and generic protein-turnover terms.
# The rules below retain only pathways whose NAMES explicitly refer to
# chromatin, histones, nucleosomes, DNA methylation/demethylation, or named
# chromatin-regulatory complexes. Curated gene sets defined below are retained
# separately and are not removed by this ontology-name filter.

strict_include_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    # Direct chromatin/nucleosome biology
    "CHROMATIN", "HETEROCHROMATIN", "EUCHROMATIN",
    "NUCLEOSOME", "CHROMOSOME_ORGANIZATION",

    # Histone modification must explicitly mention HISTONE
    "HISTONE.*(ACETYL|DEACETYL|METHYL|DEMETHYL|UBIQUITIN|DEUBIQUITIN|PHOSPH|SUMO)",
    "(ACETYL|DEACETYL|METHYL|DEMETHYL|UBIQUITIN|DEUBIQUITIN|PHOSPH|SUMO).*HISTONE",

    # DNA methylation programs
    "DNA_METHYLATION", "DNA_DEMETHYLATION",

    # Named chromatin-remodeling and Polycomb complexes
    "SWI.*SNF", "BAF_COMPLEX", "BBAF_COMPLEX", "GBAF_COMPLEX",
    "PBAF", "NPBAF", "NBAF", "POLYCOMB", "PRC1", "PRC2",
    "NURD_COMPLEX", "NURF_COMPLEX", "INO80_COMPLEX", "SWR1_COMPLEX",
    "CHROMATIN_REMODEL", "CHROMATIN_CHAPERONE",

    # Explicit epigenetic regulation (RNA-only terms removed below)
    "EPIGENETIC_REGULATION", "EPIGENETIC_MODIFICATION",
    "EPIGENETIC_PROGRAM"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

strict_exclude_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    # RNA modification/metabolism rather than chromatin-protein modification
    "(^|_)RNA_", "MRNA", "RRNA", "TRNA", "RIBOSOM", "METHYLADENOSINE",
    "N6_METHYL", "PSEUDOURID", "RNA_METHYL", "RNA_DEMETHYL",

    # Generic protein modification/catabolism without explicit histone context
    "PROTEIN_K[0-9]+_LINKED", "UBIQUITIN_DEPENDENT_PROTEIN_CATABOLIC",
    "PROTEIN_DEUBIQUITINATION", "DEUBIQUITINASE_ACTIVATOR",
    "AMINO_ACID.*ACETYLTRANSFERASE",

    # Developmental/germ-cell programs not used as core chromatin mechanisms
    "ZYGOTIC_PRONUCLE", "GERM_CELL", "SPERM", "OOCYTE"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

select_strict_chromatin_terms <- function(pathways) {
  nm <- names(pathways)
  keep_include <- grepl(strict_include_pattern, nm, ignore.case = TRUE)
  keep_exclude <- grepl(strict_exclude_pattern, nm, ignore.case = TRUE)
  pathways[keep_include & !keep_exclude]
}

c5_epi <- select_strict_chromatin_terms(c5_all)

# Save a transparent inclusion/exclusion audit for all GMT pathway names.
gmt_selection_audit <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(Source = "C5", Pathway = names(c5_all))
), use.names = TRUE)
gmt_selection_audit[, Include_match := grepl(
  strict_include_pattern, Pathway, ignore.case = TRUE
)]
gmt_selection_audit[, Exclude_match := grepl(
  strict_exclude_pattern, Pathway, ignore.case = TRUE
)]
gmt_selection_audit[, Retained := Include_match & !Exclude_match]
gmt_selection_audit[, Selection_reason := fifelse(
  !Include_match,
  "No strict chromatin/histone/DNA-methylation term",
  fifelse(Exclude_match, "Matched off-target exclusion term", "Retained")
)]

fwrite(
  gmt_selection_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("strict_chromatin_pathway_selection_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

message("Strict C5 chromatin pathways selected: ", length(c5_epi))

# Curated core programs supplement ontology terms and permit direct inspection
# of biologically important epigenetic complexes.
curated_sets <- list(
  CURATED__SWI_SNF_BAF_CORE = c(
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "SMARCD1", "SMARCD2", "SMARCD3", "SMARCE1",
    "ACTL6A", "ACTL6B", "DPF1", "DPF2", "DPF3", "BCL7A", "BCL7B",
    "BCL7C", "BRD7", "BRD9", "PBRM1"
  ),
  CURATED__PRC2_CORE = c(
    "EZH1", "EZH2", "EED", "SUZ12", "RBBP4", "RBBP7", "JARID2",
    "AEBP2", "MTF2", "PHF1", "PHF19", "EPOP"
  ),
  CURATED__PRC1_CORE = c(
    "RING1", "RNF2", "BMI1", "PCGF1", "PCGF2", "PCGF3", "PCGF4",
    "PCGF5", "PCGF6", "CBX2", "CBX4", "CBX6", "CBX7", "CBX8",
    "PHC1", "PHC2", "PHC3"
  ),
  CURATED__HDAC_PROGRAM = c(
    "HDAC1", "HDAC2", "HDAC3", "HDAC4", "HDAC5", "HDAC6", "HDAC7",
    "HDAC8", "HDAC9", "HDAC10", "HDAC11", "SIRT1", "SIRT2", "SIRT3",
    "SIRT4", "SIRT5", "SIRT6", "SIRT7", "NCOR1", "NCOR2", "SIN3A",
    "SIN3B", "MTA1", "MTA2", "MTA3", "CHD3", "CHD4"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_ACETYLTRANSFERASE_HAT_PROGRAM = c(
    "CREBBP", "EP300", "KAT2A", "KAT2B", "KAT5", "KAT6A", "KAT6B",
    "KAT7", "KAT8", "ELP3", "NCOA1", "NCOA2", "NCOA3", "CLOCK"
  ),
  CURATED__DNA_METHYLATION_WRITERS_READERS = c(
    "DNMT1", "DNMT3A", "DNMT3B", "DNMT3L", "UHRF1", "UHRF2",
    "MECP2", "MBD1", "MBD2", "MBD3", "MBD4", "ZBTB33", "ZBTB38",
    "ZBTB4"
  ),
  CURATED__DNA_DEMETHYLATION_PROGRAM = c(
    "TET1", "TET2", "TET3", "TDG", "GADD45A", "GADD45B", "GADD45G",
    "AICDA", "APOBEC1"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_LYSINE_METHYLTRANSFERASES = c(
    "KMT2A", "KMT2B", "KMT2C", "KMT2D", "KMT2E", "KMT5A", "KMT5B",
    "KMT5C", "SETD1A", "SETD1B", "SETD2", "SETD3", "SETD5", "SETD6",
    "SETD7", "SETD8", "SETDB1", "SETDB2", "EHMT1", "EHMT2", "SUV39H1",
    "SUV39H2", "EZH1", "EZH2", "DOT1L", "NSD1", "NSD2", "NSD3"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_LYSINE_DEMETHYLASES = c(
    "KDM1A", "KDM1B", "KDM2A", "KDM2B", "KDM3A", "KDM3B", "KDM4A",
    "KDM4B", "KDM4C", "KDM4D", "KDM4E", "KDM5A", "KDM5B", "KDM5C",
    "KDM5D", "KDM6A", "KDM6B", "KDM7A", "KDM8", "JMJD6", "PHF2",
    "PHF8"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_UBIQUITINATION_MACHINERY = c(
    "RNF20", "RNF40", "WAC", "UBE2A", "UBE2B", "BRCA1", "BARD1",
    "RNF2", "RING1", "BMI1", "PCGF1", "PCGF2", "PCGF3", "PCGF4",
    "PCGF5", "PCGF6", "UHRF1", "UHRF2", "CUL4A", "CUL4B", "DDB1"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_DEUBIQUITINATION_MACHINERY = c(
    "BAP1", "ASXL1", "ASXL2", "ASXL3", "USP3", "USP7", "USP11",
    "USP16", "USP21", "USP22", "USP27X", "USP28", "MYSM1", "BRCC3",
    "OTUD5", "ATXN7L3", "ENY2"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_PHOSPHORYLATION_DNA_DAMAGE = c(
    "H2AX", "ATM", "ATR", "PRKDC", "CHEK1", "CHEK2", "AURKA", "AURKB",
    "VRK1", "VRK2", "RPS6KA3", "RPS6KA4", "RPS6KA5", "PPM1D", "MDC1"
  ),
  CURATED__HETEROCHROMATIN_FORMATION = c(
    "CBX1", "CBX3", "CBX5", "SUV39H1", "SUV39H2", "SETDB1", "SETDB2",
    "EHMT1", "EHMT2", "TRIM28", "HP1BP3", "DNMT1", "UHRF1", "ATRX",
    "DAXX"
  ),
  CURATED__NUCLEOSOME_ASSEMBLY_CHAPERONES = c(
    "HIRA", "ASF1A", "ASF1B", "CHAF1A", "CHAF1B", "NASP", "NAP1L1",
    "NAP1L4", "DAXX", "ATRX", "HJURP", "ANP32E", "DEK", "SUPT16H",
    "SSRP1"
  ),
  CURATED__CHROMATIN_REMODELING_EXPANDED = c(
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "PBRM1", "CHD1", "CHD2", "CHD3", "CHD4",
    "CHD5", "CHD6", "CHD7", "CHD8", "CHD9", "ATRX", "DAXX", "SRCAP",
    "EP400", "INO80", "INO80B", "INO80C", "INO80D", "INO80E", "HELLS"
  )
)
curated_sets <- lapply(curated_sets, clean_gene)

all_epi_pathways <- c(c5_epi, curated_sets)

# Ensure unique pathway names and retain expressed genes only.
names(all_epi_pathways) <- make.unique(names(all_epi_pathways))
expressed_genes <- rownames(vst_matrix)

pathway_audit <- rbindlist(lapply(names(all_epi_pathways), function(nm) {
  original_genes <- unique(clean_gene(all_epi_pathways[[nm]]))
  matched_genes <- intersect(original_genes, expressed_genes)
  source <- sub("__.*$", "", nm)
  data.table(
    Pathway = nm,
    Source = source,
    Original_gene_count = length(original_genes),
    Expressed_gene_count = length(matched_genes),
    Expressed_genes = paste(sort(matched_genes), collapse = ";")
  )
}))

fwrite(
  pathway_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_pathway_gene_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

# Minimum 3 expressed genes permits core protein complexes to be scored.
# Interpret very small gene sets cautiously.
epi_pathways <- lapply(all_epi_pathways, intersect, y = expressed_genes)
epi_pathways <- lapply(epi_pathways, unique)
epi_pathways <- epi_pathways[lengths(epi_pathways) >= 3 & lengths(epi_pathways) <= 500]

if (length(epi_pathways) == 0) {
  stop("No epigenetic pathways retained after expression and size filtering.")
}

message("Epigenetic pathways retained: ", length(epi_pathways))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# [LABELS] Build the ID -> display-label map once, for all figures.
# make.unique() guarantees one distinct label per pathway, which ggplot
# factors and ComplexHeatmap rows require.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pathway_label_map <- setNames(
  make.unique(
    vapply(names(epi_pathways), clean_one_label, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    sep = " #"
  ),
  names(epi_pathways)
)

fwrite(
  data.table(
    Pathway = names(epi_pathways),
    Pathway_label = pathway_label(names(epi_pathways)),   # [LABELS]
    Expressed_gene_count = lengths(epi_pathways)
  ),
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("retained_epigenetic_pathways_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ============================================================
# Sample-level ssGSEA scores
# ============================================================

message("Running sample-level ssGSEA...")

gsva_exports <- getNamespaceExports("GSVA")

if ("ssgseaParam" %in% gsva_exports) {
  ssgsea_param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(
    exprData = vst_matrix,
    geneSets = epi_pathways,
    minSize = 3,
    maxSize = 500,
    normalize = TRUE
  )
  ssgsea_scores <- GSVA::gsva(ssgsea_param, verbose = FALSE)
} else {
  # Compatibility with older GSVA releases.
  ssgsea_scores <- GSVA::gsva(
    expr = vst_matrix,
    gset.idx.list = epi_pathways,
    method = "ssgsea",
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    min.sz = 3,
    max.sz = 500,
    abs.ranking = TRUE,
    ssgsea.norm = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

ssgsea_scores <- as.matrix(ssgsea_scores)
ssgsea_scores <- ssgsea_scores[, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]

write_matrix_tsv(
  ssgsea_scores,
  "Pathway",
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_scores_", run_date, ".tsv"))
)

# ============================================================
# Global and pairwise pathway-score comparisons
# ============================================================

score_long <- melt(
  as.data.table(ssgsea_scores, keep.rownames = "Pathway"),
  id.vars = "Pathway",
  variable.name = "Sample",
  value.name = "Score"
)

score_long <- merge(
  score_long,
  cluster_dt[, .(Sample, Cluster)],
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
score_long[, Cluster := factor(Cluster, levels = levels(cluster_dt$Cluster))]

global_tests <- score_long[
  ,
  {
    kw <- kruskal.test(Score ~ Cluster)
    list(
      Kruskal_Wallis_statistic = unname(kw$statistic),
      P_value = kw$p.value,
      Cluster1_median = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 1"], na.rm = TRUE),
      Cluster2_median = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 2"], na.rm = TRUE),
      Cluster3_median = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 3"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  },
  by = Pathway
]
global_tests[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]
setorder(global_tests, FDR, P_value)

# [LABELS] Add the display label next to the pathway ID.
global_tests[, Pathway_label := pathway_label(Pathway)]
setcolorder(global_tests, c("Pathway", "Pathway_label"))

fwrite(
  global_tests,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_global_cluster_tests_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

pair_defs <- list(
  Cluster2_vs_Cluster1 = c("Cluster 2", "Cluster 1"),
  Cluster3_vs_Cluster1 = c("Cluster 3", "Cluster 1"),
  Cluster3_vs_Cluster2 = c("Cluster 3", "Cluster 2")
)

pairwise_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(names(pair_defs), function(comparison) {
  pair <- pair_defs[[comparison]]

  ans <- score_long[
    Cluster %in% pair,
    {
      x <- Score[Cluster == pair[1]]
      y <- Score[Cluster == pair[2]]
      wt <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
      list(
        Cluster_A = pair[1],
        Cluster_B = pair[2],
        Median_A = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median_B = median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median_difference_A_minus_B = median(x, na.rm = TRUE) - median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        Wilcoxon_statistic = unname(wt$statistic),
        P_value = wt$p.value
      )
    },
    by = Pathway
  ]

  ans[, Comparison := comparison]
  ans[, FDR_within_comparison := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]
  ans
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

pairwise_tests[, Pathway_label := pathway_label(Pathway)]   # [LABELS]

setcolorder(
  pairwise_tests,
  c(
    "Comparison", "Pathway", "Pathway_label", "Cluster_A", "Cluster_B", "Median_A",
    "Median_B", "Median_difference_A_minus_B", "Wilcoxon_statistic",
    "P_value", "FDR_within_comparison"
  )
)
setorder(pairwise_tests, Comparison, FDR_within_comparison, P_value)

fwrite(
  pairwise_tests,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_pairwise_cluster_tests_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# ssGSEA heatmap
# [CLINICAL] No sample names; clinical tracks below the matrix.
# ============================================================

n_heatmap_pathways <- min(40L, nrow(global_tests))
heatmap_pathways <- head(global_tests$Pathway, n_heatmap_pathways)
heatmap_score_matrix <- zscore_rows(
  ssgsea_scores[heatmap_pathways, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]
)

# Top: cluster bar (also reused by the leading-edge heatmap).
column_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster,
  col = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left",            # aligned with clinical track names
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  simple_anno_size = unit(4, "mm")
)

# Bottom: clinical tracks in the same column order as the matrix.
clinical_annotation <- build_clinical_annotation(cluster_dt$Sample)

score_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

score_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_score_matrix,
  name = "Pathway Z-score",
  col = score_col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = cluster_dt$Cluster,
  column_order = cluster_dt$Sample,
  top_annotation = column_annotation,
  bottom_annotation = clinical_annotation,  # [CLINICAL]
  show_column_names = FALSE,                # [CLINICAL] hide sample names
  # [LABELS] Row IDs stay unchanged; only the printed labels are cleaned.
  row_labels = pathway_label(rownames(heatmap_score_matrix)),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = heatmap_row_fontsize),
  row_title = "Epigenetic pathways",
  column_title = "pILC tumors grouped by NMF RNA cluster",
  border = TRUE
)

save_heatmap_pdf_png(
  score_heatmap,
  file_stem = "epigenetic_ssGSEA_cluster_heatmap",
  width_in  = 15,
  height_in = max(12, 0.22 * n_heatmap_pathways + 6)   # +2 in for clinical tracks
)

# ============================================================
# Top pathway boxplots
# ============================================================

top_box_pathways <- head(global_tests$Pathway, min(12L, nrow(global_tests)))
box_dt <- score_long[Pathway %in% top_box_pathways]

# [LABELS] Facets use clean labels, ordered from most to least significant.
box_dt[, Pathway_label := factor(
  pathway_label(Pathway),
  levels = pathway_label(top_box_pathways)
)]

box_plot <- ggplot(box_dt, aes(x = Cluster, y = Score, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  # [LABELS] Long labels wrap onto two lines in the facet strip.
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Pathway_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3,
    labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 40)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Epigenetic pathway scores across pILC RNA clusters",
    subtitle = "Top pathways ranked by global Kruskal-Wallis FDR",
    x = NULL,
    y = "ssGSEA enrichment score"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = pathway_label_text_size),   # [LABELS]
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_top_pathway_boxplots_", run_date, ".pdf")),
  box_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)
ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("epigenetic_ssGSEA_top_pathway_boxplots_", run_date, ".png")),
  box_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)

# Compact cluster-level dot plot for presentation.
top_dot_pathways <- head(global_tests$Pathway, min(25L, nrow(global_tests)))
dot_z <- zscore_rows(
  ssgsea_scores[top_dot_pathways, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE],
  cap = 3
)
dot_long <- melt(
  as.data.table(dot_z, keep.rownames = "Pathway"),
  id.vars = "Pathway",
  variable.name = "Sample",
  value.name = "ssGSEA_Z"
)
dot_long <- merge(
  dot_long,
  cluster_dt[, .(Sample, Cluster)],
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
dot_summary <- dot_long[
  ,
  .(Median_ssGSEA_Z = median(ssGSEA_Z, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(Pathway, Cluster)
]
dot_summary <- merge(
  dot_summary,
  global_tests[, .(Pathway, Global_FDR = FDR)],
  by = "Pathway",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
dot_summary[, minus_log10_FDR := -log10(pmax(Global_FDR, 1e-10))]
dot_summary[, Pathway := factor(Pathway, levels = rev(top_dot_pathways))]

# [LABELS] Clean y-axis labels; most significant pathway at the top.
dot_summary[, Pathway_label := factor(
  pathway_label(Pathway),
  levels = rev(pathway_label(top_dot_pathways))
)]

cluster_dot_plot <- ggplot(
  dot_summary,
  aes(x = Cluster, y = Pathway_label, fill = Median_ssGSEA_Z, size = minus_log10_FDR)
) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
    name = "Median ssGSEA\nZ-score"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10 global FDR", range = c(2.5, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Focused chromatin programs across pILC RNA subsets",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Hypothesis-driven analysis; top pathways ranked by three-cluster ",
      "Kruskal-Wallis FDR"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Fill represents relative pathway expression within the cohort, not ",
      "absolute biochemical activation. RNA clusters were derived from the ",
      "same expression dataset."
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = pathway_label_text_size),   # [LABELS]
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("focused_chromatin_cluster_dotplot_", run_date, ".pdf")),
  cluster_dot_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)
ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("focused_chromatin_cluster_dotplot_", run_date, ".png")),
  cluster_dot_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

fwrite(
  dot_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("focused_chromatin_cluster_dotplot_data_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Cluster-versus-rest DESeq2 and ranked GSEA
# ============================================================

gsea_results <- list()
deseq_cluster_results <- list()
pairwise_gsea_results <- list()
pairwise_deseq_results <- list()

for (target_cluster in levels(metadata$Cluster)) {
  message("Running cluster-versus-rest DESeq2 and GSEA: ", target_cluster)

  dds_target <- dds
  target_group <- ifelse(
    colData(dds_target)$Cluster == target_cluster,
    "Target",
    "Rest"
  )
  colData(dds_target)$Target_vs_rest <- factor(
    target_group,
    levels = c("Rest", "Target")
  )
  design(dds_target) <- ~ Target_vs_rest

  # Refit the model for the binary target-versus-rest comparison.
  dds_target <- DESeq(dds_target, test = "Wald", parallel = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)

  res <- results(
    dds_target,
    contrast = c("Target_vs_rest", "Target", "Rest"),
    alpha = 0.05,
    independentFiltering = TRUE
  )

  res_dt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(res), keep.rownames = "Gene")
  res_dt[, Target_cluster := target_cluster]
  res_dt[, Comparison := paste0(safe_name(target_cluster), "_vs_Rest")]
  res_dt[, Contrast_type := "Cluster_vs_rest"]
  res_dt[, Direction := fifelse(
    !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0,
    paste0("Higher_in_", target_cluster),
    fifelse(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0,
      "Higher_in_Rest",
      "Not_significant"
    )
  )]
  setorder(res_dt, padj, pvalue, na.last = TRUE)
  deseq_cluster_results[[target_cluster]] <- res_dt

  cluster_safe <- safe_name(target_cluster)
  fwrite(
    res_dt,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0("DESeq2_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  ranks <- res_dt[!is.na(stat), stat]
  names(ranks) <- res_dt[!is.na(stat), Gene]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  set.seed(42)
  fg <- fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = epi_pathways,
    stats = ranks,
    minSize = 3,
    maxSize = 500,
    eps = 0,
    scoreType = "std",
    nproc = 1
  )

  fg <- as.data.table(fg)
  fg[, Pathway_label := pathway_label(pathway)]   # [LABELS]
  fg[, Target_cluster := target_cluster]
  fg[, Comparison := paste0(safe_name(target_cluster), "_vs_Rest")]
  fg[, Contrast_type := "Cluster_vs_rest"]
  fg[, Direction := fifelse(
    NES > 0,
    paste0("Enriched_in_", target_cluster),
    "Enriched_in_Rest"
  )]
  fg[, Abs_NES_for_sorting := abs(NES)]
  setorder(fg, padj, pval, -Abs_NES_for_sorting, na.last = TRUE)
  fg[, Abs_NES_for_sorting := NULL]
  gsea_results[[target_cluster]] <- fg

  fg_export <- copy(fg)
  fg_export[, leadingEdge := vapply(
    leadingEdge,
    function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"),
    character(1)
  )]
  setcolorder(fg_export, c("pathway", "Pathway_label"))   # [LABELS]

  fwrite(
    fg_export,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  plot_fg <- fg[!is.na(padj)]
  if (nrow(plot_fg) > 0) {
    significant_fg <- plot_fg[padj < 0.05]
    if (nrow(significant_fg) >= 5) {
      plot_fg <- head(significant_fg, 20)
    } else {
      plot_fg <- head(plot_fg, 20)
    }

    # [LABELS] Clean y-axis labels; top-ranked pathway at the top.
    plot_fg[, Pathway_label := factor(Pathway_label, levels = rev(Pathway_label))]
    plot_fg[, minus_log10_fdr := -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))]

    gsea_dot <- ggplot(
      plot_fg,
      aes(x = NES, y = Pathway_label, size = minus_log10_fdr, color = NES)
    ) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(target_cluster, " versus the other RNA clusters"),
        subtitle = "Ranked GSEA of chromatin and epigenetic pathways",
        x = "Normalized enrichment score",
        y = NULL,
        size = "-log10 FDR",
        color = "NES"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = pathway_label_text_size),   # [LABELS]
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )

    ggsave(
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".pdf")
      ),
      gsea_dot,
      width = 11,
      height = 8
    )
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("fgsea_epigenetic_", cluster_safe, "_vs_rest_", run_date, ".png")
      ),
      gsea_dot,
      width = 11,
      height = 8,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# Pairwise DESeq2 and ranked GSEA characterize the direction of differences
# between each pair of RNA-defined subsets.
for (comparison in names(pair_defs)) {
  pair <- pair_defs[[comparison]]
  target_cluster <- pair[1]
  reference_cluster <- pair[2]
  message("Running pairwise DESeq2 and GSEA: ", comparison)

  res <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c("Cluster", target_cluster, reference_cluster),
    alpha = 0.05,
    independentFiltering = TRUE
  )

  res_dt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(res), keep.rownames = "Gene")
  res_dt[, `:=`(
    Target_cluster = target_cluster,
    Reference_cluster = reference_cluster,
    Comparison = comparison,
    Contrast_type = "Pairwise"
  )]
  res_dt[, Direction := fifelse(
    !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0,
    paste0("Higher_in_", safe_name(target_cluster)),
    fifelse(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0,
      paste0("Higher_in_", safe_name(reference_cluster)),
      "Not_significant"
    )
  )]
  setorder(res_dt, padj, pvalue, na.last = TRUE)
  pairwise_deseq_results[[comparison]] <- res_dt

  fwrite(
    res_dt,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0("DESeq2_", comparison, "_", run_date, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  ranks <- res_dt[!is.na(stat), stat]
  names(ranks) <- res_dt[!is.na(stat), Gene]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  set.seed(42)
  fg <- fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = epi_pathways,
    stats = ranks,
    minSize = 3,
    maxSize = 500,
    eps = 0,
    scoreType = "std",
    nproc = 1
  )

  fg <- as.data.table(fg)
  fg[, Pathway_label := pathway_label(pathway)]   # [LABELS]
  fg[, `:=`(
    Target_cluster = target_cluster,
    Reference_cluster = reference_cluster,
    Comparison = comparison,
    Contrast_type = "Pairwise"
  )]
  fg[, Direction := fifelse(
    NES > 0,
    paste0("Enriched_in_", safe_name(target_cluster)),
    paste0("Enriched_in_", safe_name(reference_cluster))
  )]
  fg[, Abs_NES_for_sorting := abs(NES)]
  setorder(fg, padj, pval, -Abs_NES_for_sorting, na.last = TRUE)
  fg[, Abs_NES_for_sorting := NULL]
  pairwise_gsea_results[[comparison]] <- fg

  fg_export <- copy(fg)
  fg_export[, leadingEdge := vapply(
    leadingEdge,
    function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"),
    character(1)
  )]
  setcolorder(fg_export, c("pathway", "Pathway_label"))   # [LABELS]
  fwrite(
    fg_export,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0("fgsea_chromatin_", comparison, "_", run_date, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )
}

all_deseq_cluster_results <- rbindlist(
  c(deseq_cluster_results, pairwise_deseq_results),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  idcol = "Result_set"
)
fwrite(
  all_deseq_cluster_results,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("DESeq2_all_cluster_comparisons_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

all_gsea <- rbindlist(
  c(gsea_results, pairwise_gsea_results),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  idcol = "Result_set"
)
all_gsea_export <- copy(all_gsea)
all_gsea_export[, leadingEdge := vapply(
  leadingEdge,
  function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"),
  character(1)
)]

fwrite(
  all_gsea_export,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("fgsea_chromatin_all_cluster_comparisons_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# Combined GSEA overview across cluster-versus-rest and pairwise comparisons.
gsea_plot_candidates <- all_gsea[!is.na(padj) & !is.na(NES)]
if (nrow(gsea_plot_candidates) > 0L) {
  significant_pathways <- unique(gsea_plot_candidates[padj < 0.05, pathway])

  if (length(significant_pathways) == 0L) {
    significant_pathways <- unique(
      gsea_plot_candidates[
        order(padj, -abs(NES)),
        head(.SD, 5L),
        by = Comparison
      ]$pathway
    )
  }

  pathway_priority <- gsea_plot_candidates[
    pathway %in% significant_pathways,
    .(Minimum_FDR = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE), Maximum_abs_NES = max(abs(NES), na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = pathway
  ]
  setorder(pathway_priority, Minimum_FDR, -Maximum_abs_NES)
  display_pathways <- head(pathway_priority$pathway, 30L)

  gsea_overview_dt <- gsea_plot_candidates[pathway %in% display_pathways]
  gsea_overview_dt[, minus_log10_FDR := -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-10))]
  gsea_overview_dt[, pathway := factor(pathway, levels = rev(display_pathways))]

  # [LABELS] Clean y-axis labels; highest-priority pathway at the top.
  gsea_overview_dt[, Pathway_label := factor(
    pathway_label(pathway),
    levels = rev(pathway_label(display_pathways))
  )]

  comparison_levels <- c(
    "Cluster_1_vs_Rest", "Cluster_2_vs_Rest", "Cluster_3_vs_Rest",
    "Cluster2_vs_Cluster1", "Cluster3_vs_Cluster1", "Cluster3_vs_Cluster2"
  )
  gsea_overview_dt[, Comparison := factor(Comparison, levels = comparison_levels)]

  gsea_overview_plot <- ggplot(
    gsea_overview_dt,
    aes(x = Comparison, y = Pathway_label, fill = NES, size = minus_log10_FDR)
  ) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
      name = "GSEA NES"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10 FDR", range = c(2, 8)) +
    labs(
      title = "Chromatin pathway enrichment across pILC RNA-cluster comparisons",
      subtitle = "Preranked GSEA using DESeq2 Wald statistics",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      caption = paste0(
        "Positive NES indicates enrichment in the first group named in each ",
        "contrast; negative NES indicates enrichment in the comparison group."
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = pathway_label_text_size - 0.5),   # [LABELS]
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("chromatin_GSEA_all_comparisons_overview_", run_date, ".pdf")),
    gsea_overview_plot,
    width = 14,
    height = max(9, 0.25 * length(display_pathways) + 4)
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("chromatin_GSEA_all_comparisons_overview_", run_date, ".png")),
    gsea_overview_plot,
    width = 14,
    height = max(9, 0.25 * length(display_pathways) + 4),
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Leading-edge gene table and heatmap
# (rows are genes, so no pathway labels are drawn in this figure)
# [CLINICAL] No sample names; clinical tracks below the matrix.
# ============================================================

sig_gsea <- all_gsea[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05]
if (nrow(sig_gsea) == 0) {
  message("No GSEA pathways reached FDR <0.05; using the top 5 per comparison for leading-edge review.")
  sig_gsea <- all_gsea[order(padj, pval), head(.SD, 5), by = Comparison]
}

leading_edge_long <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(sig_gsea)), function(i) {
  genes <- sig_gsea$leadingEdge[[i]]
  if (!length(genes)) return(NULL)
  data.table(
    Target_cluster = sig_gsea$Target_cluster[i],
    Comparison = sig_gsea$Comparison[i],
    Contrast_type = sig_gsea$Contrast_type[i],
    Pathway = sig_gsea$pathway[i],
    Pathway_label = sig_gsea$Pathway_label[i],   # [LABELS]
    NES = sig_gsea$NES[i],
    FDR = sig_gsea$padj[i],
    Gene = genes
  )
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(leading_edge_long) > 0) {
  fwrite(
    leading_edge_long,
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("fgsea_leading_edge_genes_", run_date, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  leading_rank <- leading_edge_long[
    ,
    .(
      Pathway_count = uniqueN(Pathway),
      Cluster_count = uniqueN(Target_cluster),
      Comparison_count = uniqueN(Comparison),
      Minimum_FDR = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = Gene
  ]
  setorder(
    leading_rank,
    -Comparison_count,
    -Cluster_count,
    -Pathway_count,
    Minimum_FDR
  )

  leading_genes <- head(leading_rank$Gene, 75)
  leading_genes <- intersect(leading_genes, rownames(vst_matrix))

  if (length(leading_genes) >= 2) {
    leading_mat <- zscore_rows(
      vst_matrix[leading_genes, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    )

    leading_heatmap <- Heatmap(
      leading_mat,
      name = "Expression Z-score",
      col = score_col_fun,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      column_split = cluster_dt$Cluster,
      column_order = cluster_dt$Sample,
      top_annotation = column_annotation,
      bottom_annotation = build_clinical_annotation(cluster_dt$Sample),  # [CLINICAL]
      show_column_names = FALSE,                                         # [CLINICAL]
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      row_title = "Epigenetic pathway leading-edge genes",
      column_title = "DESeq2 VST expression",
      border = TRUE
    )

    save_heatmap_pdf_png(
      leading_heatmap,
      file_stem = "epigenetic_leading_edge_gene_heatmap",
      width_in  = 15,
      height_in = max(12, 0.18 * length(leading_genes) + 6)
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Compact analysis summary
# ============================================================

summary_dt <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples",
    "Cluster_1_samples",
    "Cluster_2_samples",
    "Cluster_3_samples",
    "Samples_matched_to_clinical",
    "Input_ENSG_identifiers",
    "ENSG_identifiers_mapped_to_symbols",
    "ENSG_identifiers_unresolved",
    "Genes_before_filtering",
    "Genes_after_filtering",
    "C5_epigenetic_pathways_selected",
    "Curated_pathways_defined",
    "Total_pathways_scored",
    "ssGSEA_pathways_global_FDR_lt_0.05",
    "GSEA_rows_FDR_lt_0.05",
    "GSEA_cluster_vs_rest_rows_FDR_lt_0.05",
    "GSEA_pairwise_rows_FDR_lt_0.05"
  ),
  Value = c(
    ncol(count_matrix),
    sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 1"),
    sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 2"),
    sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 3"),
    sum(sample_clinical_dt$Clinical_matched),
    sum(gene_id_audit$Is_ENSG),
    sum(gene_id_audit$Mapping_status == "ENSG_mapped"),
    sum(gene_id_audit$Mapping_status == "ENSG_unresolved"),
    nrow(dds0),
    nrow(dds),
    length(c5_epi),
    length(curated_sets),
    length(epi_pathways),
    sum(global_tests$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(all_gsea$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(
      all_gsea$padj < 0.05 & all_gsea$Contrast_type == "Cluster_vs_rest",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sum(
      all_gsea$padj < 0.05 & all_gsea$Contrast_type == "Pairwise",
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
)

fwrite(
  summary_dt,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_pathway_analysis_summary_", run_date, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste0("pILC focused chromatin pathway analysis: ", run_date),
    "Seed: 42",
    paste0("Raw counts: ", count_file),
    paste0("NMF clusters: ", cluster_gct_file),
    paste0("C5 GMT: ", c5_gmt_file),
    paste0("Clinical annotations: ", clinical_file),
    "Gene identifiers: ENSG IDs were stripped of version suffixes and mapped with org.Hs.eg.db; unresolved IDs were retained.",
    "DESeq2 prefilter: count >=10 in at least 3 samples",
    "Sample-level scoring: ssGSEA on DESeq2 VST expression",
    "Global score comparison: Kruskal-Wallis with BH FDR",
    "Pairwise score comparison: Wilcoxon rank-sum with BH FDR within each contrast",
    "Ranked enrichment: fgseaMultilevel using DESeq2 Wald statistics",
    "GSEA contrasts: each cluster versus the other two clusters plus all three pairwise contrasts",
    "Small curated gene sets with >=3 expressed genes were retained; interpret small sets cautiously.",
    "Figures use cleaned display labels with a source tag ([GO-BP], [GO-CC], [GO-MF], [HPO], [Curated]); original pathway IDs are retained in all tables alongside a Pathway_label column.",
    "Sample-level heatmaps hide sample names and show clinical tracks (tumor cellularity, pleomorphic cellularity, TILs, grade, HER2, ER, PR) below the matrix; column order is saved in pILC_RNA_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation_<date>.tsv.",
    "Clinical tracks are descriptive; cluster-clinical associations require separate formal testing.",
    "The RNA clusters were derived from the same expression data. These analyses characterize the clusters and are not independent validation.",
    "RNA pathway enrichment supports transcriptional programs consistent with epigenetic dysregulation but does not directly prove an epigenetic mechanism."
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("README_pILC_Focused_Chromatin_Pathway_Analysis_", run_date, ".txt"))
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("sessionInfo_", run_date, ".txt"))
)

message("Analysis complete.")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
print(summary_dt)

graphics.off()
```
